listing.name: ZA WARUDO
listing.summary: Turns phase and temporal shell into a jojo reference.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the visual effects of Phase Shells and Temporal Shells to resemble JoJo's Bizarre Adventure references.

description: Replaces the standard visuals for Phase Shells and Temporal Shells with a JoJo-themed effect. Initially applied only to vanilla ships, later versions extended this change to modded ships as well.
